Get nominal timepoints based on vector of timepoints

get_nominal_timepoints.Rd

Get nominal timepoints based on vector of timepoints

Usage

get_nominal_timepoints(t, adjust = 0.5, ...)

Arguments

t

vector of timepoints

adjust

sensitivity for peaks in the density curve to detect nominal timepoints. A factor of 0.5 often works well for PK data.

...

optional arguments passed to stats::density function in addition to adjust, e.g bw. The easiest way to adjust the sensitivity to peaks in the data is to use adjust.

Value

a vector of approximate nominal timepoints estimated from the data
